description: Search community-submitted GTA VI map pins by text and/or category. Returns name, category, details, position in in-game meters (x east, y north), vote count, verified flag and a link to the pin on the map.

limit.description: Maximum number of pins to return.

query.description: Words to match in the pin name or details, e.g. 'hidden package' or 'airport'.

verified_only.description: Only return pins confirmed by votes or admins.

name: search_locations
title: Search map locations
